name: drive
title: Google Drive
summary: Docs, Sheets and other files in chosen Drive folders as stars; dashboards can write to Sheets and Docs.

settings.prompt: Drive folder IDs to show (the part after /folders/ in a folder's address)
settings.help: Only files under these folders become stars. Up to 20; a single file's ID also works.

settings.prompt: Let dashboards write to Sheets and Docs?
settings.help: Asks Google for a second, edit grant. Each dashboard still needs Allow edits in the app.

secrets.prompt: Paste the OAuth client JSON your Google Cloud project gives for a Desktop app
secrets.help: Google Cloud console, APIs & Services, Credentials, Create credentials, OAuth client ID, Desktop app, then Download JSON.

secrets.prompt: Read access to Drive (Google's consent page)
Edit access to Sheets and Docs (Google's consent page, only when edits is on)
